question: 2021 to 2023 ANC coverage movement for these two: Gaya, Nalanda
gold_sql: WITH rates AS (SELECT district, year, 100.0 * anc4_completed / pregnancies_registered AS rate FROM anc_visits WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda') AND year IN (2021, 2023)) SELECT district, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN rate END) - MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2021 THEN rate END), 1) AS change_pp FROM rates GROUP BY district ORDER BY district
sql_duckdb: WITH coverage_2021 AS (SELECT district, SUM(anc4_completed) * 100.0 / NULLIF(NULLIF(SUM(pregnancies_registered), 0), 0) AS coverage_pct_2021 FROM anc_visits WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda') AND year = 2021 GROUP BY district), coverage_2023 AS (SELECT district, SUM(anc4_completed) * 100.0 / NULLIF(NULLIF(SUM(pregnancies_registered), 0), 0) AS coverage_pct_2023 FROM anc_visits WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda') AND year = 2023 GROUP BY district) SELECT c2021.district, c2021.coverage_pct_2021, c2023.coverage_pct_2023, c2023.coverage_pct_2023 - c2021.coverage_pct_2021 AS pct_change FROM coverage_2021 AS c2021 JOIN coverage_2023 AS c2023 ON c2021.district = c2023.district

WITH coverage_2021 AS (
  SELECT 
    district,
    SUM(anc4_completed) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(pregnancies_registered), 0) AS coverage_pct_2021
  FROM anc_visits
  WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda') AND year = 2021
  GROUP BY district
),
coverage_2023 AS (
  SELECT 
    district,
    SUM(anc4_completed) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(pregnancies_registered), 0) AS coverage_pct_2023
  FROM anc_visits
  WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda') AND year = 2023
  GROUP BY district
)
SELECT 
  c2021.district,
  c2021.coverage_pct_2021,
  c2023.coverage_pct_2023,
  c2023.coverage_pct_2023 - c2021.coverage_pct_2021 AS pct_change
FROM coverage_2021 c2021
JOIN coverage_2023 c2023 ON c2021.district = c2023.district;
